description: HR-94 is the official RTO code for Kalanwali sub-division in the Sirsa district of Haryana. The office is managed by the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and provides essential services including vehicle registration, driving licenses, and transport permit issuance for the local area.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Kalanwali, District Sirsa, Haryana
